entities.summary: Livonian Order, a political institution in Belarus during Polotsk Principality & Early Statehood (1101–1240). Grew from Reign of Vseslav the Sorcerer of Polotsk and Sophia Cathedral. Led to the emergence of Fragmentation & Mongol-Era Pressures.
